memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity.
Patient presents for weight management. He is a 63‑year‑old school bus driver from Indiranagar, reports gradual weight gain over 5 years, no joint pain or shortness of breath. On examination BMI 34.2 kg/m², waist circumference 112 cm, blood pressure 138/86 mm Hg, lungs clear. Smoking status: never smoked. Plan: start orlistat 120 mg with each main meal, advise low‑calorie diet and increased activity, order fasting lipid profile, glucose, HbA1c, LFT and waist circumference.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Orlistat 120 mg PO TID with each main meal.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 210 mg/dL (≤200), LDL 130 mg/dL (<100), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 180 mg/dL (<150). Fasting glucose 102 mg/dL (70‑99). HbA1c 5.9 % (4‑5.6). ALT 28 U/L (≤40), AST 24 U/L (≤40), ALP 78 U/L (30‑120), GGT 32 U/L (≤50). Waist circumference 112 cm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity with dyslipidaemia and pre‑diabetes.
Patient reports mild loose stools after meals, tolerable. Weight 98 kg (down 2 kg), waist 109 cm, BMI 32.8. BP 136/84 mm Hg. Smoking status: never smoked. Labs show LDL 118 mg/dL, HDL 40 mg/dL, triglycerides 150 mg/dL, fasting glucose 99 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.7 %. Plan: continue orlistat, add atorvastatin 10 mg at night, reinforce diet.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Orlistat 120 mg PO TID with meals.
Atorvastatin 10 mg PO HS.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 190 mg/dL (≤200), LDL 118 mg/dL (<100), HDL 40 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 150 mg/dL (<150). Fasting glucose 99 mg/dL (70‑99). HbA1c 5.7 % (4‑5.6). ALT 26 U/L, AST 22 U/L, ALP 75 U/L, GGT 30 U/L. Waist circumference 109 cm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, dyslipidaemia, impaired fasting glucose.
Patient notes occasional abdominal cramping with orlistat, otherwise adherent. Weight 95 kg, waist 106 cm, BMI 31.8. BP 132/80 mm Hg. Smoking status: never smoked. Labs: LDL 106 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, triglycerides 138 mg/dL, fasting glucose 96 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.5 %. Plan: continue orlistat, continue atorvastatin, add metformin 500 mg BD with meals.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Orlistat 120 mg PO TID with meals.
Atorvastatin 10 mg PO HS.
Metformin 500 mg PO BD with meals.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: Total cholesterol 182 mg/dL (≤200), LDL 106 mg/dL (<100), HDL 42 mg/dL (>40), Triglycerides 138 mg/dL (<150). Fasting glucose 96 mg/dL (70‑99). HbA1c 5.5 % (4‑5.6). ALT 24 U/L, AST 20 U/L, ALP 73 U/L, GGT 28 U/L. Waist circumference 106 cm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Obesity, improved metabolic parameters.
Patient reports persistent oily stools with orlistat, affecting adherence. Weight 90 kg, waist 100 cm, BMI 30.0. BP 128/78 mm Hg. Smoking status: never smoked. Labs: LDL 94 mg/dL, HDL 44 mg/dL, triglycerides 120 mg/dL, fasting glucose 92 mg/dL, HbA1c 5.3 %. Plan: discontinue orlistat due to GI intolerance, continue atorvastatin and metformin, reinforce lifestyle.
